---
title: The editor
description: Chat, Preview, Console, and the top bar.
sidebar:
  order: 2
---

Each project opens at `/projects/:id`.

**Left** is chat: your messages, the assistant replies, status while a turn is running, and plan confirmation when it appears. On a narrow screen, chat may collapse into a sheet — open it from the top bar.

**Right** defaults to **Preview**. The view switch sits next to the toolbar: **Preview** and **Data** when the project has a web app, and **Contract** when it has a contract. Open **Console** in the top bar for **Code**, **Deploy**, **Domains**, and other project settings.

**Top bar** (left to right): the current project name (switch to another project in the same workspace), **Run configuration** (model and **Run mode**), **Share**, **Publish**, and **Console**. Workspace switching, theme, balance, and the account menu live in the left rail, not this bar.

From the left rail you can also:

- Click the brand to return to the project list (**Projects home**, `/projects`)
- **New project**
- **Agents** (still in development — see [Agents](/agent/pick-agent/))
- **Members** and **Settings**
- **Credits** in the account menu (opens `/funds`)

See [Preview](/build/preview/), [Code](/build/code/), and [Data](/build/data/).
